scope: Process-only explicit modifier selection after implicit-only per-surface feedback; no pixel copy or host import-policy change
device_conditions: Default main_device nonzero and matches Vulkan render or primary DRM identity
When surface main_device is available it must exactly match default main_device
Every qualified selection requires exact raw-fourcc LINEAR in completed default feedback targeted at that exact nonzero main_device
A main_device/new-generation event invalidates committed proof immediately until feedback.done
selection: Qualified mode selects only explicit LINEAR, for all initial, surface-feedback and recreation paths
Merged per-surface VkFormat flags/modifier vectors cannot independently qualify raw alpha/opaque support
The requested raw fourcc must have completed same-device default-feedback LINEAR evidence plus advertised global LINEAR membership
Pending initial surface feedback may use completed qualified default feedback
Use identical effective selection in allocation and feedback comparison
If qualification or explicit support is missing, fail allocation with VK_ERROR_FORMAT_NOT_SUPPORTED; updated ineligible feedback marks chain suboptimal
Track pending per-main-device four-format LINEAR mask; commit only at default feedback.done and invalidate previous committed proof on every new main_device generation
preserved: Unset or other opt-in values retain existing Mesa behavior
INVALID is never treated as LINEAR
Qualified mode never mutates feedback vectors or selects their nonlinear entries
No host acceptance of implicit modifiers
Acquire-syncfd and CPU present-fence patches unchanged
known_limitation: Missing Vulkan DRM device identity fails closed; runtime controller must establish actual identity before qualification
license: MIT; complete original Mesa source notices retained

host_validation.scope: Actual selector, default-feedback callbacks and modifier-set comparison with small list-storage stand-ins; no GPU, full Wayland protocol decoder, complete Mesa build or device qualification
review_regressions: Render-to-primary and primary-to-render pending default feedback cannot reuse a committed mask
Same-device pending generation invalidates old proof
ARGB LINEAR plus XRGB INVALID cannot qualify opaque XRGB; corresponding BGRA/RGBA and reverse-alpha cases refused
Every qualified result is one explicit LINEAR and cannot alias merged feedback vectors

runtime_scope: One controlled 2,400-frame native cube run at 640x480 -> 1280x688 -> 640x480; 16 explicit LINEAR buffers, two changing display samples per size and pre/post compute checks. Full-port, conformance and explicit retirement are unqualified.

same_candidate_controls.opt_out: Legacy explicit-to-implicit modifier regression reproduced after resize; changing pixels do not establish resized presentation.
same_candidate_controls.copy_wsi: Stock vkcube, 2,400 frames, 25.637 seconds, four changing visual samples; no compositor restart.
